name: openstax: 1.1 Definitions of Statistics, Probability, and Key Terms

facts: A statistic describes a sample, whereas a parameter describes a population.
The mean exam score is 84.3 to one decimal place.
A sample space contains all possible outcomes.
An event is a subset of the sample space.

name: openstax: 3.2 Independent and Mutually Exclusive Events

facts: Replacement leaves the second blue probability at 4/7.
After removing a blue marble, the second blue probability is 1/2.
Binomial trials are independent with constant success probability.
Withdrawal is success when the random variable counts withdrawals.
The standard normal has mean 0 and standard deviation 1.
A score of 11 with mean 5 and standard deviation 2 has z-score 3.
